newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch H1 car sales steady, VW/Audi biggest seller.
newsitem.headline: Dutch H1 car sales steady, VW/Audi biggest seller.

text.p: Sales of new cars in the Netherlands totalled 289,612 in the first half of 1997, only marginally down from 289,857 in the year-ago period, the Dutch automotive association RAI said on Monday.

The top of the sales league was headed by VW/Audi, whose first-half sales rose to 41,957 from 40,173. General Motors fell to second with sales of 38,551 cars, down from 42,671 in the first six months of 1996.
The RAI association did not give any forecast for the full-year's sales. In 1996, car sales rose by six percent to 473,474.
